batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c JJ Bumrah b KA Pollard

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c HH Pandya b KA Pollard

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Mandeep Singh b Ravi Bishnoi

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b NT Ellis

balls.text: low full toss on middle. Driven to long on, and the throw from the deep is wayward. Allows them to take two and Punjab Kings made 135 for 6
full on off. Comes down the ground and drives to the right of cover
good length outside off. Flat-bats a mistimed slog to wide long off for one
back of a length, outside off. Flat-batted to wide long on for a single
around the stumps. Full on middle, and he smacks it straight past the bowler to long off
yorker first ball. Aimed at leg stump. Nudged towards cover for a quick single
better connection. Length ball on middle, and looks to club it leg side. Mistimed,  but in the gap at deep midwicket

put down! Full on leg stump. Looks to slog leg side, but it's a 130kph ball. Mistimed, ball in the air, and two fielders run to midwicket for a catch. Bumrah runs from the pitch, Suryakumar runs from deep midwicket. No collision, but Suryakumar drops the difficult chance

miles in the air and taken by Pollard at wide long on. Full, almost in the slot, and he looks to hit a six over extra cover. Timing isn't perfect, has the elevation but not the distance. Pollard takes a reverse-cup catch
they scurry across for one. Good length ball, misses the swipe to the leg side. Hooda runs across as soon as the ball gets to de Kock
good length on leg stump. Angling across. Backs away to pull, but misses out. Through to the keeper
yorker length on middle. Dug away for a single
slower ball. Good length wider outside off. Slapped to cover's left, who dives to intercept
yorker attempted, almost perfectly delivered. He looks to drill one straight down, but ends up inside-edging into his pads

slower ball. Well deceived. Back of a length on off and angling into leg stump. Brar wants to flick it behind square but he's through the motions too early. The ball hits him near the tummy well after he has completed the shot
around the stumps. Length ball outside off, and he drags one to midwicket
good length outside off, and flat-batted to long on for a single
back of a length around leg stump but angling sharply across Brar. Wants to ramp it over third man but the bat was quite far away from the ball
full on middle. Opens the bat's face and drives in front of square. Krunal has to run to deep extra cover from deep point
good length on leg stump. Clipped off his pads to midwicket. Big gap there to Boult in the deep
full on middle, and angling across. Brar looks to defend towards cover but it goes past the outside edge to the keeper
ball rolls away to the off side after hitting his pad
full on middle stump. Looks to fend it back, but takes the outside edge to third man
fullish, wide outside off. Rocks back and slaps a cut through to the deep
good length on off. Turning into middle. Punched back to Chahar off the back foot
full on middle. Driven to long on for a single
good length just outside off. Punched off the back foot to deep point

overpitched, and Markram misses the sweep altogether! Full on off stump. Markram looks to play it leg side but the ball goes under the bat, and crashes into off stump. Misjudges the length and pays the price for it. But a crucial contribution from Markram
wayward first ball and Markram puts it away. Good length ball on middle. Angling into leg, and he flicks it hard and fine
caught and bowled? No! Full toss on off stump. Bunted back to Boult, who dives to his right to take the catch. But it pops out! Tough chance, was not expecting it. Fifteen off the 15th
back of a length slower ball on middle and angling across to off. He stays tall and purposely slices this rising delivery over backward point for four more

good length ball on middle. He cuts it from quite close to his body, and ends up slicing the shot. Just past the diving Saurabh Tiwary at point, and Chahar in the deep has to run quite a fair distance to stop the four
full on off stump. Smothers a drive to wide long off for a single
good length outside off. Stands tall and punches it through cover for another four! Fifty partnership in style
slower ball to start off. Full and wide, and Markram simply drills a drive through the infield! Races away to extra cover boundary for four
full outside off stump. Pushed to cover
full on off. Big stride forward to defend
full outside off. Turning away. Wants to slap it over extra cover but slices it over point instead. Rolls away to deep point and Boult has to put in the hard yards to intercept
full on middle. Skips down the ground and pushes it to long on
good length outside off. Turning in. Late dab to short third man for a single
flighted delivery outside the off stump. Hooda swoops down on it as he sweeps it to fine leg for a single
full on middle. Flicked behind square to deep backward square leg
full on leg stump. Worked off his pads to deep midwicket
length ball on leg. Skidding further down. Flicked off his waist to deep midwicket
full on off. Flicked to the right of long on for just a single
full on middle. Angling into leg, and flicked to deep backward square leg. Another double for Hooda, keeping im on strike
good length on middle. Punched to long on's right and Hooda picks up the second run with ease too
full on middle. Looks to work it to mid on, but the leading edge takes the ball past Chahar's left instead. Rolls away to mid off
full just outside off. Driven down ther ground to long off. Hardik's on the boundary line
good length on middle. Nudged to the leg side
full on middle stump. Inside out drive past the bowler's left to long off
full outside off. Turning away, and pushed to deep extra cover
yorker length just outside off stump. Dug away to the off side
full on middle, and pushed off the front foot to the leg side. Surya at midwicket hovering
thumped! Short ball on middle, and Hooda stands tall before swiveling to the on-side for a pull!
fullish ball on off stump, and he checks a defensive shot to cover
good length just outside off. Cuts it to Krunal at deep point for just one
full on leg stump. Pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
good length outside off stump. Nudged to point
good length ball, slightly slower. Too early to pull and mistimed.  Nearly carries to Suryakumar at short midwicket
good length on off stump. Bunted back to mid on
good length, on off. Tapped back to the bowler to mid on
good length on off and angling into the stumps. Punched back to NCN off the back foot
full on off. Presses forward and places a beautiful drive past cover's left for four! Pings off the bat, pure timing.
full outside off stump. Slaps a drive in front of square. Krunal putting in the hard yards in the deep
fullish ball, outside off. Googly turns in. Punched off the back foot to deep extra cover
tossed up outside off. A drive that is squirted away to point
skiddy delivery. Length ball on off and going through. Fended back to the bowler off the back foot
much better shot Another full ball outside off stump. Turning away, and he smothers a drive past cover's left for four!
full outside off. Driven with the turn to cover

another short ball climbing on to the batter, Pitches on off, and angles in, as he dabs that toward point and takes off. There is a direct hit at the keeper's end by Krunal, and Mumbai appeal for run-out. The umpire goes upstairs, and replays show Hooda was well in
good length ball on middle and clipped to deep square leg

sharp bounce, and great accuracy there! Welcomes Hooda with a short ball on off, which is angling in after getting good bounce off the surface. Fended with a little sway away, and with his bottom hand off

appeal for leg before, and given! But Pooran reviews. Bumrah nails that yorker to hit Pooran's front pad on middle and leg, as the batter misses his flick off what was a low, dipping full-toss. No inside edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. Replays show the yorker would have landed bang on the base of middle stump, and it is three reds. So the decision stands, and Kings lose their review
fullish ball and just outside off. Angles in a touch, as he dabs that to third man
full ball near his pads, and driven to the left of mid-on

bowls this from wide of the crease on a full length on middle, as Markram clips that behind to fine leg. Bumrah at short fine is beaten to his left, and he gives the chase right till the end, but can't stop that
another short delivery on middle and leg, and angling away. Pulled to deep midwicket with a swivel

gloved to short fine leg! Looks to pull this short of a length ball on off, but there is the lack of pace again from Pollard, who rolls his fingers over the ball to bowl with scrambled seam. Rahul goes for the shot, but is foxed, as Pollard grabs his 300th wicket in all T20s
another good length ball on off, and whipped to the left of midwicket
good length ball on leg, and angling down further. Wide called, with Pollard chuckling with half an appeal for caught behind

picks out long-on! Gayle goes cheaply. Change of pace from Pollard again - as expected - and he goes on a good length on middle. Gayle clears his front leg to pull, but gets that right down to the fielder, who barely has to move. Another blow for Kings, who have already started slowly
starts with a slower ball on a good length on off. Pushed to deep midwicket

yorker -length ball on middle, and jammed back to strike Rahul, who leaps but is still hit by the ball. The ball ricochets to Krunal, who whips the bails off at the non-striker's end to try and catch Rahul short, but the umpire says he was in. In fact, Krunal withdrew the appeal himself
shortish in length on middle, and punched to long-off with the full face of the bat
full again on middle and leg, and this is flicked to deep midwicket
full ball on middle, and he goes low to clip that to square leg

huge appeal for leg before by Krunal, and given! Mandeep in some discussion for a review with Rahul, but decides against it. He goes to sweep this full ball on off by going down on his back knee, but seemed to be a little too across off while trying to slog that over the leg side, and missed. The ball struck him on middle and off, and the umpire raised his finger. Replays show the ball would have hit middle
good length on middle, and clipped to the right of mid-on with a step down
good length ball on off, and Rahul pulls to Boult again at deep square, and with a swivel
pulled just short of Boult at deep square leg. Slower ball on a short of a length on off, and again the ball doesn't get up. Rahul pulls, but uncomfortably and away from his body
short of a length ball on middle, and angling in. He misses his pull as the ball strikes his body
on a good length on off, and finds midwicket with his pull
pulls this good length ball on off to fine leg. The ball doesn't quite get off the surface though
full ball in the driving length just outside off. Just a tad of movement away from the batter, who drives to mid-off with the full face of the bat
another short ball, and he gets a top edge over the keeper! Not in control of that pull, with the ball climbing on to him. But Mandeep won't mind
short of a length ball on off, and pulled to fine leg with a swivel
bowls short on off, with this one angling in. Pulled to fine leg, where the fielder runs to his left
again bowls this pretty full, and wide of off too. Darts away after pitching, as de Kock goes low to his right to collect that
crunches this between cover and mid-off! Drives forward to this fuller ball on off, which is right in the length for him to present the full face of the bat
pitches it full and slightly wide of off. A hint of movement away from the batter, as he lets that go
bisects cover and cover-point! Low full-toss wide of off, and he drives that with a horizontal bat to find the gap for four
fuller ball on middle and off, and he presents the full face of the bat to drive to long-off
shortish in length and just outside off. Punched to long-off
bowls slower, and fullish and wide of off. He waits for it come, but finds extra cover with his loft
flighted ball, and a full-toss wide of off. Reaches out for it to jam that to cover. And it is a no-ball
goes a touch fuller on middle, and again Rahul flicks that to the right of the man at deep midwicket
short of a length on middle, and he rocks back to clip that to deep midwicket, who is one of the two men on the boundary
a touch of inswing now, as Rahul gets an inside edge on to his pads while trying to clip that full ball on middle

finds the gap between point and cover! Leans forward to present the full face of the bat to this full ball in the driving length just outside off, and creams that along the ground as this ball doesn't swing
on a good length on middle and off, as he opens the bat face to dab that to point
fullish on his pads, and once more it darts in a touch. Clipped to fine leg for another single in the region
goes full on middle this time, with the angle into the right-hander again. Clipped behind to fine leg
short delivery pitching outside leg, and Rahul lets that go as it flies off the surface. Wide called
full ball on middle, and angling in. Flicked to fine leg with the movement
very full and tossed up on middle. Turned away to deep midwicket
spinning into him him off a fullish length on off, as it is clipped toward deep midwicket
fuller on off, and blocked forward off the inside edge
sharp turn into him! Rahul makes room, as Krunal goes on a good length outside off and the ball spins toward leg side
fuller ball on middle, and flicked toward square leg for another single
good length ball on off, and clipped toward deep midwicket to get off the mark

and that's that! Back of a length outside off. Hardik clears the front leg and flat-bats a hammering shot down to long on. Simple catch for Hooda on the long-on boundary line but the ball bursts through his hands! Mumbai Indians win by six wickets

good length just outside off. He opens his stance and muscle a flat-batted shot. Just over midwicket and beats the two fielders in the deep too! Deep midwicket tries to stop it, Deepak Hooda tries to dive from long on. Both fail
back of a length, outside off. Flat-batted over cover. Long off and deep extra cover converge, and Pooran puts in the dive to stop the four
back of a length outside off. Angling into off stump. No protection at third man, and so that's an obvious shot for Pandya. Cuts it over the infield, and it goes over short third man for four
back of a length wider outside off. Can cut it square but the extra bounce takes the ball over the bat to the keeper
full and wide outside off. Muscles a sloggy shot to long on for a single

full on middle. Goes deep in his crease and looks to smack it straight back. In the air, but Arshdeep can't grab it with his left hand. Bursts through his fingers again, and umpire Virender Sharma ducks for cover one more time. 13 off the over, the most expensive of the innings
up and over! In the slot after bowling so well today. And Pollard was waiting for that length. Full and wide, and Pollard walks to the off side before drilling a six over long off
full toss outside off and Pollard simply leans into a cover drive. Through the infield to the wide long off region for four!
yorker length, but just outside leg stump. Umpire gives it a wide even though the ball could've hit Pollard's boot if he didn't change his stance
full just outside off. Opens the bat's face and drills a shot to deep backward point for a single
full outside off stump. Angling away again. Can't hit it through
full and wide outside off. Successfully bowls the wide yorker. Hardik can't get bat on ball. Inside the tramlines too!
good length just outside off. This time he clobbers the cut through the infield to deep point
back of a length outside off again. Another cut attempted. Misses the shot once again
short and wide. Takes the pace off slightly too. Hardik looks to cut but misses
flicked with ease! Fullish on leg stump, Pandya clears the front leg and uses his bottom hand to smack it over midwicket for a 97m six
good length on off. Hardik stays put in his crease, opens the leg side, and pulls it hard through midwicket for a one-bounce four! Played with disdain
back of a length on off and sharply angling in. Hardik doesn't sway away, doesn't duck, it hits him near the shoulder. Hardik unmoved. Just shrugs it off
good length on middle, and worked through midwicket to the fielder in the deep
good length just outside off stump. Stands tall, and punches it to cover. No run
fullish, just outside off stump. Tap and run towards cover point for one
back of a length, outside off stump. Extra bounce. Through to the wicketkeeper. Not a wide either
full on middle and leg. Flicked to deep backward square leg for one

he's walking! The set batter is gone. Slower ball, full and wide. Tiwary is through his slap too early, and it takes a small edge. Ball pops up but then dips low late. Rahul has to jump forward to pocket the catch. But the umpires have gone to the TV umpire. Clean catch? Clean catch.
full outside off stump. Pushed to cover off the front foot
full on off. Another leg-side slog attempted. Hit flat to the fielder at deep midwicket
that's been smacked In Tiwary's arc, and he won't miss out. Full on off, and he gets low before going big- over cow corner
play and miss. Full outside off and turning away further. Goes for an against-the-turn slog over midwicket. But misses
full on middle, and turning across to off. A very late cut to short third man
full on middle stump. Drills it down the long on for a single
full ball on middle and leg stump. Nudged to the leg side for a single

dropped! Full toss on middle and he's thumped it back straight. Singh sticks his left hand out to catch, but it bursts through his hands.  Umpire Virender Sharma ducks too, going onto the ground out of precaution. Ball rolls down to long on
full on off. Mistimed drive to the right of cover. Ball rolls past him to long off, allowing the duo to take one
overpitched on off, and drilled to cover
dropped at point! Full outsiden off. Slices the drive and it flies behind square. Brar jumps and tries to take a catch with two hands but it pops out! Slower ball induced the outside edge
full on leg stump, and clipped off the boots to deep midwicket
good length, on leg stump. Muscles a flick to deep square leg for a single
good length outside off stump. Stands tall and punches to wide long off for a single
good length, quite wide outside off. Flat-batted down the ground to mid off
good length outside off stump. Stands tall and punches to cover
full on middle stump, and clipped to wide long on for a single
good length on middle and off. Guided to backward point
change of pace again, as Tiwary pushes that toward mid-on
slower ball and a low full-toss, which is drilled between extra cover and mid-off! Arshdeep goes for the yorker, but lands it right in the arc for Tiwary to drive

And Arshdeep throws it right back and close to Tiwary's box! Oh my, that looks so painful although he is still smiling. Tiwary pushed back a pretty full on off to the bowler, who threw back; but why he did that I am not sure. Kings players and the Mumbai physio converge around Tiwary, who is now back on his feet after feeling the heat and going down
really full on middle, and clipped to midwicket as the ball angles in
gets an inside edge off his drive. Goes after this full ball on off, which is angling in. But his intended cover drive instead means the ball is down to fine leg
starts with a slower ball on a good length just outside off. Dabbed toward cover after letting the ball come to him
fullish ball on off, and turning away. Pushed to deep point after allowing the ball to turn
and an inside edge again. Tosses it up full on off, and Hardik gets his drive to the off side to deep square leg instead
googly again, but pretty full and wide of off. Hardik shoulders arms to that
bowls full and straight. Blocked off the front foot
tossed up very full and just wide of off. Hardik misses his attempted loft
inside edge first ball, and that trickles behind for four! Bowls full and outside off, as Hardik goes low to defend, but doesn't read the googly
goes for the yorker, but bowls a low full-toss on middle. Pushed down to long-on, as Shami has his hands on his head

inside edge next ball! Again looks to pull, but this ball is not all that short and nor does it get up a lot off the good length just outside off. de Kock gets an inside edge on to his stumps, and Kings strike again. This should be getting interesting if wickets continue to fall
beats long-on with his pull! Shami bowls short and outside off, and de Kock plays with a good, free swing, as the fielder sees that cross the fence to his left
good length ball just outside off, as he taps that to cover from close to his body
fuller and on a driving length outside off. Firmly placed to deep point
good length ball on off, and punched to mid-off. The fielder can't collect that cleanly while running forward
pretty full and just outside off. Uses his wrists to swing that to long-on
much fuller on off, as he pushes this back. Brar dives to his left and just behind the non-striker to stop that
opens the bat face to run that good length ball outside off to the left of Gayle at short third man. He dives, as the ball trickles off him to allow an extra run
he skips down, and slams that over long-on! Brar pitches that full on off, and Tiwary swings his arms full throttle to pocket six
bowls fuller and just outside off. Clipped to long-on from deep in his crease
pretty full on middle, and driven down to long-on

Markram runs to his right and dives, and drops a very tough catch! He had to run a long way there, as the ball kissed his fingers and popped out to go for four, as de Kock elegantly lofted that full ball outside off and turning away from him with good positioning of the arms
and tries the reverse again off this full ball outside off, but this time finds short third man
short and wide of off, and slashed aerially to deep point while playing away from his body
back of a length ball and a touch wide of off. Clipped to deep midwicket after rocking back
goes for the reverse-sweep to the full ball outside off, but is beaten
bowls full and just outside off. de Kock sweeps after going low, as Arshdeep runs to his left from deep square leg to stop that
chips that aerially to long-on after leaning forward, as Markram bowls full and just outside off
another full ball on middle, which is pushed to long-on for another single
hint of turn away, as he taps this full ball on off with the open face of the bat
full again on middle and leg, and clipped to deep midwicket
appeal for run-out at the bowler's end! The umpire goes upstairs. But Tiwary is in safely. Tiwary clips this full ball on his pads to short fine, and they take off for a rapid run
good length ball on off, and flicked to deep midwicket after waiting for the ball to come
slower ball now. On a good length on middle and off, and blocked by Tiwary
clips that to fine leg! That was on a good length right on his pads, as he just had to tickle that to the right of short fine leg, who was inside the circle
another good length ball, but this is just outside off. Pushed back to the bowler from deep in his crease
good length ball on middle, as he dabs that to cover
good stop by Bishnoi at mid-off and to his right. Slower ball at just 108kph on a full length outside off, as de Kock drives forward while leaning into the drive
full delivery on off, and closes the bat face to push that to mid-on
makes room, and cuts that between point and cover-point! Markram pitches that short on off, and he cuts late to bisect the two fielders. This should relieve Mumbai a bit
misfield at cover, and that allows a single. de Kock dances down, but Markram bowls full and wide of off, as de Kock slashes at that
bowls on a back of a length on off, with the ball turning in. Punched to the man at cover
fuller on off, and driven to long-off
fullish length and just outside off, as the ball threatens to come into him. Pushed back to the bowler off the inside edge
full ball on middle, and clipped toward midwicket, with calls of "very nice" from Rahul behind
short of a length and just outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket, with the ball not quite getting up a lot
leading edge, but in the vacant cover region! Goes to flick this full ball on his pads, but gets an edge toward cover to allow him to get off the mark

bowled him first ball! Zips the googly through Suryakumar's bat and pad to strike middle stump. Bishnoi on a hat-trick now. Pitches it fullish and just outside off, and gets it to turn into the batter, who looks to drive first ball but is beaten. And the huge gap in between means the ball crashes into his stumps

And Rohit slogs it straight to mid-on! Look to sweep this full ball outside off, which is coming in a tad, as he is low on his back knee while playing to slog-sweep slightly away from his body. Early breakthrough for Kings, as the opposition captain departs
good length ball just outside off, and punched to short third man's left
de Kock goes for the drive, but is beaten outside off as the ball is full and wide
change of pace, and he goes for a yorker again. But it is a low full-toss instead, which de Kock chips toward mid-on after making room and staying deep in his crease
again backs away, as Arshdeep lands the yorker right on middle. de Kock digs it to cover with the horizontal bat
makes room at the last moment, but Arshdeep still follows him to go on a good length outside leg. Pushed to cover for another dot in the over
bowls this much fuller on off, as de Kock finds Gayle at midwicket with his flick
pulls his length back to on a good length on off, as de Kock punches that between cover and cover-point. The latter gives the chase after the former dives to his right in vain
starts with a near yorker-length ball on middle, as de Kock clips that to mid-on
good length ball on middle, and clipped to the right of the man at square leg. Fine leg chases that to his left
another one tickles his pad, as Rahul stretches out his left glove to nab that one-handed. This is again full on leg, and moves down further after pitching
short of a length ball on off, and pulled on to his body off the inside edge. A scoring opportunity missed, and mind you, Rohit is a great puller too
drives on the up to beat point and third man! This is in the driving length and a touch wide of off. He plays without any foot movement, but still finds the gap for four

there is a faint sound as Rahul takes it to his left and appeals for caught behind, but the umpire doesn't give that. That was pitched full and outside leg, and kept angling down. Replays show that clipped Rohit's pad instead
full delivery and just outside off in the channel, as it shapes away after pitching. Defended from close to his body
steps down to this good length ball on off, which is turning in. Pushed to long-on
fuller and just outside off. Driven to mid-off with the full face of the bat. de Kock wanted a single, but is sent back
another pretty full ball on leg, as de Kock clips that to square leg's right
very full and tossed up outside leg. Wide called
tossed up really full on off, as he opens the bat face to drive to the right of the man at point, who dives but doesn't get a hand
full and straight on off. Blocked back with his head down
fullish ball on off, and turning in a touch. Clipped to deep midwicket to get off the mark
